description: Coerce a victim and relay its NTLM to LDAPS (channel binding not enforced) for the same LDAP abuse.

telemetry.detail: Authentication coercion (PetitPotam MS-EFSR, PrinterBug MS-RPRN, DFSCoerce, etc.) generates distinctive RPC traffic to the victim.
Relayed NTLM authentication lands as a logon on the relay target.
Coercion-plus-relay chains are heavily signatured; NTLM relay is a well-known, widely detected pattern.
Directory write via the relayed LDAPS session under DS-change auditing.

prerequisite_privilege: Network position; LDAPS channel binding not enforced
abuse_primitive: Coerce + relay to ldaps:// for RBCD / shadow credentials.
notes: Same as the LDAP variant over TLS; viable only without EPA / channel binding.
